title: No Duping
description: Various toggles for disabling dupes (rails; carpets; tnt; gravity blocks; tripwire hooks).
body:
This data pack aims to disable the following duplication glitches: rails; carpets; string; tnt; gravity blocks; tripwire hooks. It does this by deleting the duplicated item or entity after it has been created in the general set-ups.

Notes: dupes are enabled by default, so disable them in the settings.

Hide the “world warning” when enabling this datapack
Setup / settings (1.21.6+) for server owners or single players
The configuration is now handled through an in-game dialog menu.

You can open it in either of these ways:

/trigger no_dupe_tutorial
From the pause menu (in-game)
The current settings can still be viewed with:

/trigger no_dupe_tell_settings
Older versions (previous setup via commands)
